name: Zegna
why: Suits, tailoring and knitwear from a company that owns its wool mill in Biella and traces its fiber.
origin: Founded in Trivero, Italy, in 1910 by Ermenegildo Zegna as a wool mill.

notes.wool: it is the Biella mill — fiber to finished suit
notes.finbro: the MD suit — what the promotion is tailored in
notes.ital: The Trivero mill, and the Oasi Zegna above it — the family planted half a million trees on the mountain across the twentieth century. Few houses have altered their own landscape.
notes.racquet: Club dress rather than sportswear — the jacket you wear to the match, not the shirt you play it in.
notes.boat: Crewed-deck resort dress, cut in cloth the house wove itself. Comfortable rather than nautical.

notes.craft: The Zegna Group owns its wool mill in Trivero and a chain of Italian textile and yarn makers (Filiera page names each with acquisition date). The sources I could read do not show who sews the garments, shoes or leather goods. Owned cloth-making covers the fabric, not demonstrably the whole range. [held at 5: owns its mill chain; owned garment plants not confirmed because the 20-F was unreachable]

craft_evidence.owned_d: Group-owned TEXTILE Filiera (zegnagroup.com/en/our-filiera): Lanificio Ermenegildo Zegna, Trivero (wool fabrics, group-owned since 1910; 'complete production process is carried out by the Zegna Group'); Tessitura di Novara (silk, acq. 2009); Pettinatura di Verrone, Biella (combing, 2012); Bonotto, Molvena (majority 2016); Dondi (jersey fabrics, majority 2019); Tessitura Ubertino (majority 2021); Cappellificio Cervo (hats, 2018); Filati Biagioli Modesto (cashmere yarn, majority w/ Prada 2021); Luigi Fedeli e Figlio (knitwear/yarn, minority 2023). GARMENT-making (tailoring, shirts, shoes, leather goods) facilities NOT confirmed in sources read; 20-F not reachable.
